premises.text: Gen Y often spends without knowing where their money goes
premises.evidence_span: I have no idea where my money goes

premises.text: Expense input under three seconds with pattern/frequency-ranked tags keeps logging proactive and fast
premises.evidence_span: input any expense in under three seconds

premises.text: App never asks for credit card, bank information, or even a name
premises.evidence_span: We'll never ask you for your credit card or bank information, not even your name

premises.text: Gamification—experience points, tokens, achievements, and leveling—makes tracking fun and rewarding
premises.evidence_span: we're going to make it fun and rewarding

premises.text: Users can create subcategory budgets that track totals and breakdowns for tagged spend areas
You Versus Them compares a user's spending to demographic peers for actionable insights
premises.evidence_span: with the You Versus Them feature, I can show you insights like never before

premises.text: Spends Tokens unlock partner deals; companies pay to put the right deals in front of the right audience
premises.evidence_span: working with companies to get the right deals in front of the right audience

premises.text: Spends is always free for users, with web backup of the mobile account
premises.evidence_span: For users, Spends will always be free

value.text: Fun, fast budgeting and money tracking for a generation that otherwise does not watch where cash goes
value.evidence_span: solve the problem of budgeting and tracking your money. Not like everybody else, but fun and fast

causal_links.evidence_span: I have no idea where my money goes

notes: Four differentiation claims split where separately failable; XP/tokens/achievements/levels folded as gamification cascade (§4.1.7). Proactive spending philosophy folded into fast-input premise. Web dashboard treated as backup facet of the product.
